subject: Feedback on the volunteer budget note
text:
Hello,

I wanted to ask quietly for your feedback on the note I sent this morning. An unanticipated expense appeared for the storage rental, and I rewrote the short appeal. I am not sure whether the tone feels too apologetic or simply unclear. If you have a few moments, could you briefly tell me whether the request makes sense and whether the amount sounds reasonable? I would rather adjust it before sending anything else for now.
